Amazon devices such as the Fire TV and Fire tablet also support live sports. If you don't see live sports on your device, update your app to the latest version. Android: Open the Google Play Store app, search for Prime Video, and then tap Update. iOS: Open the App Store, search for Prime Video, and then tap Update.How can I find live sports and events on Prime Video?All live events are accessible on the Live & upcoming row as you scroll down the main Prime Video home page.Can I record, fast forward, and rewind live sports and events?To see a list of features supported for your event, go to the live sports and events help page.Which live sports and events can I watch, what do I need to do to watch them, and how can I manage my subscriptions?To see subscription and content information for your event, go to the live sports and events help page.I still need help watching my live event.If you see "this video is unavailable" or "unavailable due to regional restrictions" that means the game isn't available in your area due to regional or national broadcast rights for that specific game. If you see "enable location for event availability" on mobile devices, location services might be turned off. To fix this, go to your device's settings and turn on location services for Prime Video. If you have anti-virus software, make sure it doesn't block Prime Video from accessing location services.
